-- Find the geometry of Kamjong
WITH kamjong AS (
    SELECT geometry
    FROM read_parquet('divisions_area')
    WHERE id = '48a8eacf-f240-44ba-95f8-4734abc5e1c9'
),

-- Find all counties that touch Kamjong
neighbors AS (
    SELECT d.id,
           d.names."primary" AS name,
           d.geometry
    FROM read_parquet('divisions_area') d
    JOIN kamjong k
      ON ST_Touches(d.geometry, k.geometry)
    WHERE d.subtype = 'county'
)

-- Return the matching candidate ids
SELECT id,
       name,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geometry
FROM neighbors
WHERE id IN (
    '1a47ae21-8852-461a-b5a3-fc67be78673a',
    '48a8eacf-f240-44ba-95f8-4734abc5e1c9',

WITH target AS (
    SELECT geometry
    FROM read_parquet('divisions_area')
    WHERE subtype = 'county'
      AND names."primary" = 'Hnahthial'
      AND region = 'IN-MZ'
)
SELECT
    d.id,
    d.names."primary" AS name,
    ST_AsGeoJSON(d.geometry) AS geometry
FROM read_parquet('divisions_area') AS d
JOIN target
  ON ST_Distance(d.geometry, target.geometry) <= 100000   -- 100 km in meters
WHERE d.subtype = 'county'
  AND d.id <> (SELECT id FROM target);

    d.id,
    d.names."primary" AS name,
    ST_AsGeoJSON(d.geometry) AS geometry

    ON s.id = '5043e424-4da2-4e2f-b055-c452af7586e0'   -- Shamli

    d.subtype = 'county'
    AND ST_Touches(d.geometry, s.geometry);
